incident_spec.summary: Excessive creation of temporary tables on disk in MySQL, despite configuration adjustments.
symptoms: High percentage of temporary tables created on disk.
Performance concerns related to disk-based temporary tables.
incident_spec.mechanism: Implicit temporary tables exceeding memory limits or involving unsupported data types (e.g., TEXT/BLOB).

facts.evidence: Post mentions configuration changes to reduce disk-based temp tables.

facts.key: TEXT/BLOB fields force disk-based temp tables
facts.evidence: Answer 1 explains MEMORY engine limitations with TEXT/BLOB fields.

facts.key: Queries with GROUP BY or ORDER BY may create temp tables
facts.evidence: Post and answers discuss query patterns causing temp tables.

assumptions: The database schema includes TEXT/BLOB fields or large columns.
Queries involve GROUP BY, ORDER BY, or UNION operations.
unknowns: Exact schema and query workload causing temp table creation.
Whether other configuration settings contribute to the issue.

feasibility.rationale: Synthetic data can reproduce the mechanism of disk-based temp tables caused by TEXT/BLOB fields and memory limits.

schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS large_table (id INT PRIMARY KEY, group_col INT, order_col INT, text_field TEXT, blob_field BLOB)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS small_table (id INT PRIMARY KEY, ref_col INT)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO large_table (id, group_col, order_col, text_field, blob_field) SELECT n, MOD(n, 100), MOD(n, 50), REPEAT('text', 10), REPEAT('blob', 10) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
INSERT INTO small_table (id, ref_col) SELECT n, MOD(n, 10) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= 100

tables.name: large_table
tables.purpose: Primary table to simulate temp table creation due to TEXT/BLOB fields and query patterns.
tables.distribution_notes: Includes TEXT/BLOB fields and large columns to trigger disk-based temp tables.

tables.name: small_table
tables.purpose: Reference table for joins or filters in queries.
tables.distribution_notes: Used for join fanout and query complexity.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT * FROM large_table WHERE group_col = 1 ORDER BY order_col DESC LIMIT 10
calibration_queries.objective: Verify temp table creation due to ORDER BY and memory limits.
expected_evidence: Disk-based temp table usage visible in the plan.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT group_col, COUNT(*) FROM large_table GROUP BY group_col
calibration_queries.objective: Verify temp table creation due to GROUP BY and large columns.
expected_evidence: Disk-based temp table usage visible in the plan.

validation_criteria: Disk-based temp table creation observed in EXPLAIN.
Queries trigger temp table creation as expected.
symptom_evidence: High percentage of disk-based temp tables in query execution.
mechanism_evidence: TEXT/BLOB fields and large columns cause temp table creation.
Queries with GROUP BY or ORDER BY trigger temp tables.

experiment_request.dba_description: Investigate and reproduce excessive disk-based temp table creation in MySQL.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS large_table (id INT PRIMARY KEY, group_col INT, order_col INT, text_field TEXT, blob_field BLOB)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS small_table (id INT PRIMARY KEY, ref_col INT)

rationale: The reproduction focuses on the mechanism of disk-based temp table creation due to TEXT/BLOB fields and memory limits. Synthetic data and queries simulate the conditions described in the post.
